//: Who this language pack is, and where it lives. Read by the pack build, which folds it into
the gubal-manifest.json inside the published zip, where the plugin reads it.
language is the BCP-47 code; its lower-case form is the last segment of repo and names the
archive. updateUrl is where an installed pack finds the next release: once set it is a promise, and an
address that stops answering tells every install that the pack is abandoned.
issuesUrl is where the plugin sends somebody who found a wrong line.
name: FFXIV Language Pack (ES-ES)
author: Mini Ashdam
